title: Your First Weekend at The College of Wooster, Shared as Cards
description: A low-key first-weekend sequence that starts with campus bearings, adds food and arts, and leaves room for recreation or a scheduled event.

cards.title: Start with a self-guided campus loop
cards.subtitle: First stop · 847 College Avenue
cards.notes: Pick up a campus map by the Admissions Office entrance, then use the self-guided walk to place the buildings you will revisit.
cards.short_summary: Begin by turning the campus map into a familiar route.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says campus maps are available next to the Gault Admissions Center entrance and welcomes self-guided tours.
cards.access_notes: Use the self-guided-tour option; office services may follow separate hours.

cards.title: Find the steps and arch at Kauke Hall
cards.subtitle: Orientation landmark · campus center
cards.notes: Walk to the steps while you are orienting yourself; this is the documented gathering point for the new-student class photo and March Through the Arch.
cards.short_summary: Locate a recognizable orientation landmark early.
cards.evidence_claim: The College's 2026 new-student orientation schedule lists the class photo and March Through the Arch at Kauke Hall Steps.
cards.source_title: New Students | The College of Wooster
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; no event access is implied outside its scheduled use.

cards.title: Make Lowry your meal-and-meetup anchor
cards.subtitle: Midday stop · Dining Hall and Allen Commons
cards.notes: Use a meal break to learn the building: the Dining Hall and Allen Commons both appear in the College’s new-student orientation schedule.
cards.short_summary: Get oriented in a central dining and gathering building.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identifies Lowry Center as the heart of campus dining and lists its Dining Hall and Allen Commons as orientation locations.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and payment requirements vary; check campus dining information before visiting.

cards.title: Pause at Old Main Café
cards.subtitle: Afternoon reset · lower level of Kauke Hall
cards.notes: If you want a short break after your walk, head downstairs in Kauke Hall and check the café menu for coffee, bagels, or sandwiches.
cards.short_summary: A café stop inside a landmark you have already located.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says Old Main Café is in Kauke Hall's lower level and serves made-to-order coffee drinks, locally sourced bagels, and sandwiches.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require purchase; confirm current service before going.

cards.entity_name: The College of Wooster Art Museum
cards.title: Spend an hour with the current exhibition
cards.subtitle: Early afternoon · Ebert Art Center, 1220 Beall Ave.
cards.notes: Check the exhibition page before you go, then enter from the north side of Ebert Art Center for a focused gallery visit.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art stop with rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says the Art Museum and all of its events are free and open to the public; it is on the north side of Ebert Art Center.
cards.source_title: The College of Wooster Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Regular public hours are listed by the museum and can change during breaks.

cards.title: Continue outside on the sculpture tour
cards.subtitle: Art walk · around campus
cards.notes: Download the museum’s tour guide and use it for a walking loop that connects eight documented artworks across the College grounds.
cards.short_summary: Turn the campus walk into a self-guided art activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Museum offers a self-guided campus sculpture tour featuring eight works of art around campus.
cards.source_title: The College of Wooster Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Download the tour guide from the museum page; outdoor route conditions vary.

cards.title: Get familiar with Scot Center
cards.subtitle: Late afternoon · recreation and courts
cards.notes: Take a look inside before committing to a routine; the College identifies the building as a place for fitness classes, workouts, and court games.
cards.short_summary: Find the campus recreation building and its activity options.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says students can take a fitness class, work out in Williams Fitness Center, or play on Scot Center courts.
cards.access_notes: Recreation access, reservations, and facility hours may vary; verify with campus recreation.

cards.title: Try a first workout at Williams Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Active break · inside Scot Center
cards.notes: Bring what you need for a short workout, then use the visit to learn how the fitness space fits into your weekly campus routine.
cards.short_summary: Add a simple movement break to the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identifies Williams Fitness Center as a workout option within its Scot Center recreation offerings.
cards.access_notes: Confirm eligibility, equipment rules, and current facility hours before entering.

cards.title: Check the schedule for a Fighting Scots game
cards.subtitle: Weekend option · athletics venues
cards.notes: Look at the College’s current events listings, choose a scheduled game that fits, and go with a new friend or orientation-group connection.
cards.short_summary: Use a scheduled campus game as an easy shared outing.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes its Fighting Scots program as spanning 23 NCAA Division III teams and directs visitors to the Scots schedule.
cards.access_notes: Only attend a currently scheduled event; ticketing and venue access vary by sport.

cards.title: Close with a scheduled performance
cards.subtitle: Evening option · Freedlander Theatre
cards.notes: Check the campus events calendar for a performance, then make it an evening plan rather than assuming a show is on every weekend.
cards.short_summary: Choose a calendar-listed arts event for the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says theatre and dance productions run throughout the year, and its events page publishes campus performances and gatherings.
cards.source_title: Campus Events | The College of Wooster
cards.access_notes: Confirm the event’s date, venue, admission, and ticket details through the campus calendar.
